answer: The village punishes no lie with a fine; it punishes with an audience. Every deed an account posts is narrated, in plain detail, to its three oldest bonds - peers who vouched years ago and quietly lose face when their ward misbehaves. A sybil voyage is cheap to begin, but each fake account must drag real sponsors under scrutiny they never consented to, spending attention that cannot be minted. Trust spirals outward from whoever staked their name on you, so farming aliases means gardening trouble in other people's soil, and they will notice before the harvest.
